summary: Explicit /user/login route: saved email and password in the revealed password pane. The website handles Enter on the password input and owns the login request.

sources.title: Explicit login route disables automatic SSO redirects
Optional password entry point and native button
Password sign-in component before generated ids (v1.793.0)
Password sign-in component with autocomplete email (v1.570.0)

selectors.locator: From v1.794 emailId is `${uid}-email` with autocomplete username; up to v1.793 the input is id email with autocomplete email (username from v1.79x). TextInput or a plain input renders type email.
From v1.794 passwordId is `${uid}-password`; up to v1.793 the input is id password. Both render type password with autocomplete current-password and handle Enter on it.

staysInteractive.note: OAuth/SAML providers, their account selection and approval remain interactive; no third-party credential origin is granted.
No automatic MFA-code plan is introduced; any identity-provider challenge remains interactive.
Disabled password login, first-time setup and workspace selection remain interactive. Native preparation only opens the reviewed password entry point; it never selects an SSO provider.

notes: Pinned public source only; no account test or hosted DOM capture. Native preparation may click the exact Log in without third-party button once before any credential grant, only for the selected Windmill profile on /user/login. An already visible password pane needs no click. SSO, MFA, setup and recovery remain interactive. Synthetic fixtures contain no vendor scripts or account data. Self-hosted releases up to v1.793 render #email/#password (fixture.v1793.html; autocomplete email before v1.79x, fixture.legacy.html); the selectors accept both layouts.
